entities.name: Keimon
entities.description: A vedalken stormcaller from Esper who served Archmage Drathus.

entities.name: Archmage Drathus
entities.description: Keimon's master, killed at the Maelstrom.

entities.name: Naya
entities.description: The shard to which they aimed to deliver a spell capsule.

entities.name: Maelstrom
entities.description: A chaotic storm of raw mana.

entities.name: Nayan behemoths
entities.description: Colossal creatures that invaded the sanctum.

events.summary: Alien mana and invading behemoths disrupt Keimon's research sanctum; he conjures a storm and downs one behemoth.
events.quote: His lightning spell succeeded in downing one behemoth, but the second proved impervious to his magic.

events.summary: Keimon carries his wounded master toward the Maelstrom to deliver a spell capsule to Naya.
events.quote: They aimed to deliver a critical spell capsule to Naya

events.summary: Drathus is killed in battle with an elemental creature at the Maelstrom.
events.quote: In the ensuing battle, Drathus was killed.

events.summary: Overcome by the Maelstrom, Keimon detonates the spell capsule, killing himself to stop the surge.
events.quote: activated its detonator, terminating himself to stop the mana surge

relations.quote: He showed deep loyalty to his master, Archmage Drathus
